item.subject: science
item.stem:
Riya's ballpoint pen suddenly stops writing while she is doing her homework. She guesses that the ink in the refill is finished. To test her guess, she opens the pen and looks at the refill. She finds that the refill is still half full of ink.

What should Riya decide from this test result?

options.A: Her guess is supported, because a pen stops writing only when the ink is finished.
options.B: Her guess is supported, because she tested it by opening the pen.
options.C: Her guess is not supported, so she should think of a different reason, such as a blocked nib.
options.D: Her guess is not supported, so she should stop testing and throw the pen away.
